desc.zh: 从镜像前缀推导完整候选集，逐项比较距离与平局。
desc.en: Derive a complete set of mirrored-prefix candidates and compare distances and ties.

complexity: O(d) time; O(d) space for d ≤ 18 decimal digits (bounded integer arithmetic)

concepts.name: Palindrome candidate completeness
concepts.description: Neighboring prefixes and digit-length boundaries cover the nearest other palindrome.
